Ambi prepares eight facility installations for peak season

Ambi Robotics describes new installations and service preparation as customers anticipate 9–10% more volume than last peak season.

The Robot Report ↗5 November 2026English editorial summary
StoryImages 1Videos 3

New sites ahead of higher volumes

COO Stephen McKinley told The Robot Report that Ambi is installing new systems at eight facilities before peak season, mostly a new AmbiSort configuration. Customers anticipate 9–10% more volume than last peak; that is a demand forecast, not a measured robot-speed improvement.

People and spares are part of capacity

Part of the team visits sites and trains operators while others remain ready to respond. Critical spares, including computers, are positioned at customer sites and regional US locations. The approach targets recovery time as well as picking and sorting performance.

Updates remain controlled

Ambi says production AI does not independently retrain itself. Collected data informs retraining and controlled A/B tests before fleet rollout. An internal assistant helps support staff using service-ticket knowledge, while customers still deal with people. The preparation combines hardware, maintenance and supervised software changes.
